verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an app marketplace or a catalog of thousands of third-party integrations. The REST API, OAuth 2.0 and MCP support are developer building blocks for constructing integrations, not a marketplace. Calendar subscriptions and embedded cloud files from Figma, Google Docs and Dropbox are adjacent features, not a way to connect the workspace to thousands of tools.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can connect my workspace to thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace
